The architecture ontology is currently the **generated production ontology** (`ontologies/software-architecture.ttl`), not a temporary hand-written stub.  
The prior stub (`ontologies/architecture.ttl`) was retired in commit `7f015a32`, replaced by Trivyn-generated output (v0.8.0) with the production namespace `https://trivyn.io/ontologies/software/architecture/domain/`.
